name: Financial Instrument Attributes SD 19
definition: Provides additional information regarding underlying security details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

IncomeSourceCountry.name: Income Source Country
IncomeSourceCountry.definition: Country of source income for the security.

DTCAssetClass.name: DTC Asset Class
DTCAssetClass.definition: Classification of instruments into asset classes at DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation).

DTCAssetType.name: DTC Asset Type
DTCAssetType.definition: Further classification of instruments into (issue) asset types at DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation).

SecurityEligibilityIndicator.name: Security Eligibility Indicator
SecurityEligibilityIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the security is eligible for holding at DTC.

TickerSymbol.name: Ticker Symbol
TickerSymbol.definition: Ticket symbol for the event security (underlying security).

LinkedSecurity.name: Linked Security
LinkedSecurity.definition: Security whose characteristics mirror the event security for purposes of FCP eligibility and tax relief. Certain derivative securities like HOLDR may have certain events where the source of payments are from an underlying security.

OriginatingSecurityIdentification.name: Originating Security Identification
OriginatingSecurityIdentification.definition: Represents the 'original' security identifier of the event. It is used in the scenarios like "partial call" where there are 2 events. The first event distributes into the Contra CUSIP, a temporary security; and on the second event that temporary security becomes the underlying security of the event. This element is used in the second event to point to the original CUSIP.

DIVANNSecurityDescription.name: DIVANN Security Description
DIVANNSecurityDescription.definition: Security description associated with DIVANN legacy system which contains additional values such as NTL for interest only notional.

ForeignIssueFlag.name: Foreign Issue Flag
ForeignIssueFlag.definition: Indicates whether the event security is a foreign issue. This element will be initially used for CD Early Redemptions AC63.

MoneyMarketInstrumentFlag.name: Money Market Instrument Flag
MoneyMarketInstrumentFlag.definition: Indicates that underlying security is a Money Market Instrument.
